requirements.title: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS must enforce password complexity

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: Use of a complex password helps to increase the time and resources required to compromise the password.

descriptions.label: check
descriptions.data: Verify the value of 'minlen' in /etc/security/pwquality.conf is 15 or more.

descriptions.label: fix
descriptions.data: Configure Ubuntu 22.04 LTS to enforce a minimum 15-character password length by adding 'minlen = 15' to /etc/security/pwquality.conf.

requirements.title: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS must configure audit logging

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: Without establishing what type of events occurred, it would be difficult to establish, correlate, and investigate security incidents.
